name: Harada Sanosuke
source:
He is the captain of the Shinsengumu's 10th Division.
He is easly agitated and prone to profane outbursts, but he is better known for his loyality and jovial nature.
Unlike many others in the Shinsengumi, his wapon-of-choice is a spear, and he is often tasked with guarding the rear units on the battlefield.

[Taken from [url=http://ideafintl.com/hakuoki-kyoto/home.php]official english site[/url]]
